reviews_h2: Straight from the people who called us

reviews.author: randy abrams
reviews.text: Chris and his guys are awesome. Does great work at a fair price and not gonna do it unless needed. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Wendy Perry
reviews.text: What a GREAT experience! Was otw to the beach for the day to do some yard work spiffing up at my place... with gardening friend and my big hound dog. Just as we got onto 17 from 58, all my gauges went to zero! And AC turned warm. My friend was on the phone with her brother who said that sounded like alternator... and we'd get as far as the battery charge would get us. On a hope and prayer, as we got closer, I called the Maysville Police Dept. and spoke with Christie (?sp) to tell her of our situation and ask if a service center in town. She pointed me towards Maysville Tire and Services Center, and place I'd been by so many times. I asked if she'd stay on the phone with us for the couple miles to make sure we got there, and she was happy to do that! We literally rolled into their lot, truck cut off right there! Although they were so busy, Aaron assured me they'd check it out and also said it was likely alternator and could get one quickly and get us back on the road. Within about an hour and a half, we were! We were invited into their nice cool lobby (Rufus my hound dog too)... others there waiting with us and all friendly folks. They have lots of toys to keep children busy.... a book shelf full of children's books... a big aquarium with 2 turtles that were fascinating to watch... bathroom was very clean and even had a little potty for toddlers! From Aaron, Chris (owner) to Joyce (front desk), everybody was so kind and friendly! What was so worrisome and frustrating on a HOT day turned out to be as pleasant as could be and I'll always toot the horn when going by there. I'm so glad to know of such a great place in the vicinity when on the road in that area and so near my happy place in Cedar Point too! Just 20 minutes away. Thanks to you ALL for such a friendly North Carolina small-town experience. Hope I don't need y'all again, but if I do, glad we "met."

reviews.author: Chris Holleman
reviews.text: Had an alignment done on my 2015 Chevy Colorado which has a decent lift and big wheels! They did a great job taking care of the need! Making it right! Drives great now! Thanks Maysville Tire!

reviews.author: Vanessa Cotton
reviews.text: Chris is absolutely amazing! I needed vehicle maintenance and he went above and beyond to assist me and my family! He is very knowledgeable, friendly, and so good hearted. There are not many perfect fit customer service representatives left. I absolutely recommend Maysville Tire and service to anyone needing parts or vehicle service. Thank you Chris!

reviews.author: Renee Baker
reviews.text: By far the best mechanic and tire shop in the area! They are always quick and do a great job. The staff treats you like family and are always so welcoming and helpful.

reviews.author: Keila
reviews.text: I was traveling alone with my daughter to a horse show when my tire showed low pressure- not only did they fit me in but they fixed the tire and caught the fact that my rim was cracked. Chris let me borrow a rim to get us to the show on time while he has mine repaired. If every business was as good as this one we’d all be better off. He put our safety first, let us borrow a rim, and charged a fair price. Highly recommend!! Hard to find good people- Chris and his staff are the best.

reviews.author: Jared Lanier
reviews.text: A month ago my father had a flat and cruised into Maysville Tire, a week ago I had the same issue and also ended up at Maysville Tire. We were each treated with professionalism and quick service, getting us back on the road and about our business in less time than we expected, especially as drop-ins. Great service, and seem like nice people. We hope not to have to visit in an emergency next time but will definitely be pricing our new tires through them from here on out. Always nice to support local business while getting big business like service.

reviews.author: Heather Ellis
reviews.text: Great place to get auto repair work and your vehicle inspected . I am in and out in about fifteen to twenty minutes for inspections or my fleet of vehicles. I love Chris and Aaron. We also get our tires there.

reviews.author: Mazaradie
reviews.text: Chris and his team always come thru with excellent service and speed! Always willing to help us out and we have been regular customers since he first opened! Great guy and great business, would recommend to anyone in the area!

reviews.author: Krysti Wingfield
reviews.text: Brought 2 vehicles here to have the tires swapped, but keep the rims on the perspective vehicle. They did exactly as I asked & rotated the tires for free since they were switching them around anyway. I did have to pay for them to rebalance the tires, but that was expected. Reasonably priced & was done faster than I'd expected. Been coming here ever since for like 5 yrs now. I bring all my vehicles here for inspection (they do any county in NC, not just Jones & Onslow). Much rather support these guys than some "big-boxed" store. Great family run place right there next to the Handy Mart in Maysville on 58. Pull in where the gate is just before the building.

reviews.author: Jels Pr
reviews.text: Chris came highly recommended by close friends of mine. They won't take their car anywhere else. Both of my vehicles have needed work, and I've trusted maysville Tire. They're reasonably priced, and I always feel welcome whenever I'm there.

reviews.author: Diana P
reviews.text: 5 stars is not a high enough rating. My husband and I were just traveling thru Maysville when we had a sudden flat tire in pouring rain. We called Maysville Tire and a kind fellow immediately came to where we were - about a half mile from their business location - filled the tire and told us to hurry to their shop where they promptly took care of the issue. This place is what all service businesses should strive for. So friendly, informative and genuine. What a jewel!

reviews.author: Kristin
reviews.text: I went in today for an emissions inspection, I called them an hour before closing asking if they could fit me in bc I was in Maysville trying to get my car registered and NC plates. They said sure come on in! They were super friendly and it was done in 20 minutes, so I had time to make it back to Maysville Town Center and got my plates today! They saved me a 30 min trip and a lot of stress! I HIGHLY RECOMMEND!! MAYSVILLE TIRE & SERVICE CENTER employees are super professional love local businesses that work hard to earn your business!

reviews.author: Saila Simone
reviews.text: I went there for a tire change and the guy had the. Tire gun turned up too high when he changed the tire. I didn't know until I got another flat. I went to somebody else to get it fixed.And they told me that you ever put my tires on before, Put them on way too tight and stripped two of the tire bolts, which is unsafe to drive. These other people did me right. When I called maysville tire and service center to tell them what two people told me so far that they did to my tires, he acted like he could have cared less. I refuse to do business with these people anymore because of all the wasted money they caused me. My neighbor down the road said not to do business with them because that's what they do. But I had already had the tires done by them.

reviews.author: Haley Hardin
reviews.text: Great, convenient, family-owned business. They treat their customers good and do great work. Thank y'all so much!

reviews.author: Jeffery Field
reviews.text: These folks do good work and they're honest too. Chris has the best tire prices around, I have purchased 2 sets from him. Give them a try.

reviews.author: Harry Donnelly
reviews.text: The guys over at Maysville Tire & Service helped me out and got me back safe and sound on the road within about a half hour I was even able to catch my son's bus before it even had a chance to get to my son's drop off.. great customer service and you can actually feel the care they give out to every customer.

reviews.author: Stacy Connolly
reviews.text: I'm from out of town. I was traveling and my brakes stopped working. I had to have my car towed and it was dropped off here. They fixed it very quick and it was much less expensive than I expected. I would recommend them to everyone.

reviews.author: joeL.v
reviews.text: These guys seriously know what they're doing! Great family owned operation with friendly and knowledgeable mechanics. For a small fee they'll even provide local roadside assistance. Had a flat at the park one day, and they came to me!

reviews.author: Lakota Hickman
reviews.text: I have gotten my oil changed and this time I decided to go somewhere different and they stripped my drain plug, didn't tell me I needed a new one I am unhappy. Also didn't tell my a out a transmission fluid leak. I will not return.

reviews.author: Joan Beasley
reviews.text: Awesome... the guys are patient, hard workers. Will I go back bet mine dollar bottom. You know it. Not from here, traveling through. However I come back every year. See yal then. Still need tires . So See you in a few weeks. Joanie the croatan lady

reviews.author: David Barnes
reviews.text: Always get great service. If I moved away from Pollocksville. I would still bring my cars and trucks to Chris and his technicians. They do a wonderful job and their prices are great

reviews.author: Gary Eubanks
reviews.text: Very professional and these guys know what they are doing. Also -tire experts that will guide you to the right Tire for your vehicle! Pleasant and friendly service with fair pricing!

reviews.author: Shelley Reddy
reviews.text: All of the guys at Maysville tire have always been very helpful and courteous. I've been going there for years and will continue to do so. I highly recommend them!!!

reviews.author: Michael Webb
reviews.text: I have live in the area for 10 years, and I bring all of my vehicles here. This is what a small town business is supposed to be like. Keep up the good work!

reviews.author: Caitlin
reviews.text: My favorite place to take my vehicles for inspections, oil changes, tires, etcetera. Great service, very helpful and friendly staff. Always happy walking out the door, thanks you guys!

reviews.author: Will Bradley
reviews.text: The staff at Maysville Tire are nothing short of exceptional. They will go above and beyond to ensure your vehicle is back on the road in no time(without breaking the bank). I give my highest recommendations to Maysville tire.

reviews.author: Jenn Likens
reviews.text: Best customer service I've ever had! Does great work and always makes sure I'm satisfied when I leave.

reviews.author: nate digman
reviews.text: Great guys, great crew. Fast turnaround and great pricing. Top notch customer service and quality of work.

reviews.author: Jonathan Morton
reviews.text: Friendly staff and are willing to do anything they can to help you. Inspections... Tires... Alignments... Services, they do it all! Great people to do business with.

reviews.author: chris Lee
reviews.text: Quick, VERY QUICK, and very friendly. Will be using them for all local automotive fixes. Very impressed every time i go here. Thank you!!

reviews.author: Dallas
reviews.text: Staff was really helpful. They got my truck in when they said they would and got the tires put on in a timely manner.

reviews.author: Sherry Hilsinger
reviews.text: Stopped in for an inspection for our vehicle, fast and efficient service with a comfortable waiting area. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Cheryl Brown
reviews.text: This place is the bomb! Fixed my hub and did an inspection in less than a day. The cost was only $80!!
